1051.description: A gentle spinal stretch on hands and knees, rounding the back like a cat. It loosens the spine.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders.
Tuck your chin and round your back toward the ceiling.
Draw your belly button in and hold for a few breaths.
Return to a neutral spine.
Repeat slowly, holding the rounded position 15-20 seconds.

1115.description: An advanced inverted press with hands on the straps, working the triceps and shoulders strongly.
instructions: Set the straps low and place your hands in the handles in a pike position.
Kick or walk your feet up into an inverted position with a tight core.
Bend your elbows to lower your head between the handles.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your body steady, using a wall or spotter if needed.
Come down carefully when finished.

1179.description: Small alternating leg kicks that burn the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with hands under your hips.
Lift both legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small, quick alternating moves.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Continue for 20-40 seconds.

1243.description: A lying core drill where arms and legs reach out while your back stays down. It trains core control.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms pointing up and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower your right arm and left leg toward the floor.
Return and switch sides.
Move slowly and keep your back flat.

1307.description: A push-up with your hands on a bosu ball. The unstable surface makes your chest, shoulders and core work harder to stay steady.
instructions: Place the bosu ball on the ground with the flat side facing up.
Position yourself in a push-up position with your hands on the outer edges of the bosu ball.
Engage your core and lower your body down towards the bosu ball by bending your elbows.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将博苏球平放在地上，平面朝上。
将自己置于俯卧撑位置，双手放在博苏球的外边缘。
弯曲肘部，调动核心力量，将身体向博苏球方向降低。
伸展双臂，将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1371.description: Seated calf raise with a barbell resting on your thighs. The bent knee shifts the work to the soleus muscle under the calf.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and a barbell resting on your thighs.
Place the balls of your feet on a raised platform, such as a block or step.
Lower your heels as far as possible, feeling a stretch in your calves.
Raise your heels as high as possible, contracting your calves.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地板上，杠铃放在大腿上。
将脚掌放在升高的平台上，例如木块或台阶。
尽可能降低脚后跟，感受小腿的拉伸。
尽可能高地抬高脚后跟，收缩小腿。
重复所需的重复次数。

1435.description: A squat with the bar resting low across the rear delts, which leans you forward a bit more. It loads the glutes, hamstrings and lower back heavily.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and the barbell resting on your upper back.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, slowly lower your body by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，杠铃放在上背部。
保持挺胸，核心收紧，弯曲膝盖并向后推臀部，慢慢降低身体。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行或略低于地面。
暂停片刻，然后用力推动脚后跟，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1499.description: A band-resisted overhead press from behind the neck. It trains the shoulders and triceps with rising tension.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends at the back of your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your head forward.
Press your hands straight up until your arms are extended.
Lower slowly back behind your head to shoulder level.
Only use this variation if your shoulders move comfortably in that position.

1563.description: A standing leg swing forward and backward, loosening the hips. A nice warm-up for the hips and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand tall next to a wall or support and hold on with one hand.
Swing your outside leg forward with a straight knee.
Swing it back behind you, squeezing your glute.
Keep your torso upright and avoid arching your lower back.
Do all reps on one side, then turn around and switch legs.

1627.description: A preacher curl with an EZ bar and a close grip. It emphasizes the outer biceps.
instructions: Sit on a preacher curl bench and place your upper arms on the pad, gripping the ez barbell with an underhand grip.
Rest your triceps on the pad and fully extend your arms, keeping your back straight.
Slowly curl the barbell towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Lower the barbell back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在牧师弯举凳上，将上臂放在垫子上，反手握住 ez 杠铃。
将三头肌放在垫子上，充分伸展手臂，保持背部挺直。
慢慢地将杠铃向肩膀弯曲，收缩二头肌。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
将杠铃放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1755.description: A weighted dip off a bench or chair with legs extended. Loads the triceps harder than the bodyweight version.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench or chair with your hands gripping the edge next to your hips.
Slide your butt off the front of the bench with your legs extended in front of you.
Keep your back close to the bench and your elbows slightly bent.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子的边缘，双手抓住臀部旁边的边缘。
将你的屁股从长凳前面滑下来，双腿在你面前伸展。
保持背部靠近长凳，肘部稍微弯曲。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地板平行。
伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1819.description: Hanging lightly from a pulley handle with palms up stretches the biceps and forearm. The pulley lets you control how much weight you load.
instructions: Hold a pulley handle with an underhand grip and your arm straight.
Lean your body weight back gently until you feel a stretch in the biceps and forearm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1883.description: Lying stretch using a stability ball for support while opening the outer hip.
instructions: Lie on your back with your calves resting on a stability ball.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Roll the ball gently to bring your legs toward your chest.
Feel the stretch in the outer hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1947.description: A standing side stretch that lengthens the outer hip and thigh.
instructions: Stand next to a wall and cross one leg behind the other.
Push your hips sideways toward the wall.
Lean your upper body away from the hips until you feel the outer hip stretch.
Keep both feet flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2139.description: Cranking pedals with your hands on an upper body ergometer. Gets your heart rate up using the arms and shoulders.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and handlebar position to a comfortable level.
Sit on the ergometer with your back straight and feet on the pedals.
Grasp the handles with your hands and position your arms at a 90-degree angle.
Start pedaling with your hands, pushing and pulling the handles in a controlled motion.
Continue pedaling for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将座椅高度和车把位置调整至舒适的水平。
坐在测力计上，背部挺直，双脚放在踏板上。
双手抓住手柄，并将手臂呈 90 度角。
开始用手踩踏板，以受控的动作推拉手柄。
继续踩踏所需的持续时间或重复次数。

2203.description: A seated roller drill that rolls forward and back to work shoulder control. Helps with shoulder mobility and posture.
instructions: Sit on a flat surface with your legs extended in front of you.
Hold the roller with both hands, palms facing down, and place it on your thighs.
Lean forward slightly and roll the roller away from your body, extending your arms straight in front of you.
Pause for a moment, then slowly roll the roller back towards your body, bending your arms and bringing the roller back to your thighs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在平坦的表面上，双腿在身前伸展。
双手握住滚轮，掌心朝下，将其放在大腿上。
稍微向前倾，将滚轮滚离身体，将手臂伸直在身前。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将滚轮向身体方向滚动，弯曲手臂，将滚轮拉回到大腿处。
重复所需的重复次数。

2267.description: A seated machine leg press that drives the legs forward to build thigh and glute strength with back support.
instructions: Adjust the seat and sit with your back flat against the pad.
Place your feet on the platform about shoulder-width apart.
Push through your heels until your legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees.
Bend your knees slowly to return.
Repeat for the planned reps.

2331.description: Pedalling a cycle cross trainer with arms and legs moving together. Steady, low-impact cardio.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the cycle cross trainer.
Place your feet on the pedals and grip the handlebars.
Start pedaling in a smooth and controlled motion.
Maintain a steady pace and increase the resistance if desired.
Continue pedaling for the desired duration of your cardio workout.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在自行车交叉训练机上。
将脚放在踏板上并抓住车把。
开始以平稳且受控的动作踩踏。
保持稳定的步伐并根据需要增加阻力。
继续踩踏您的有氧运动所需的持续时间。

2395.description: A bicycle crunch variation that trains the abs and obliques through alternating twists.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg.
Switch sides in a smooth pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for the planned reps or time.

2459.description: Flipping a heavy tire end over end by driving through your legs. Builds full-body power, especially glutes and legs.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing the tire.
Bend your knees and hinge at the hips, lowering into a squat position.
Reach down and grab the bottom edge of the tire with both hands, fingers facing towards you.
Engage your glutes and leg muscles, and explosively drive through your legs to lift the tire off the ground.
As the tire flips over, use your upper body strength to guide it and maintain control.
Once the tire is fully flipped, quickly step back and reset your stance.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，面向轮胎。
弯曲膝盖并以臀部为铰链，降低至蹲姿。
向下伸手，用双手抓住轮胎的底部边缘，手指朝向您。
调动你的臀部和腿部肌肉，并爆发性地推动你的腿，将轮胎抬离地面。
当轮胎翻转时，用上半身的力量引导轮胎并保持控制。
轮胎完全翻转后，迅速后退并重置姿势。
重复所需的重复次数。

2523.description: A sit up on a decline bench with a twist to work the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Sit up while rotating your torso to one side.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Alternate sides each rep.

2715.description: Carrying a heavy timber on your shoulder, training full-body strength and stability.
instructions: Lift the timber onto your shoulder and balance it.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk with short, steady steps.
Keep the load balanced and avoid leaning to one side.
Set it down under control, then switch shoulders.

2779.description: Rotating the upper arm outward, which works the rotator cuff muscles at the back of the shoulder.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with your elbow at your side bent at 90 degrees, forearm pointing forward.
Rotate your forearm outward, keeping the elbow tucked against your side.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2843.description: A core-driven move where arms and legs stretch out together and then draw back in.
instructions: Lie on your back and curl your head and shoulders up.
Hug your knees to your chest.
Reach your arms overhead while extending your legs.
Circle your arms and draw your knees back in.
Keep your lower back down.

2907.description: Pushing a power sled while walking backward. Builds quad strength and conditioning.
instructions: Stand behind the sled with your back to it and grip the handles.
Brace your core and lean slightly into the load.
Walk forward in powerful steps, pushing the sled.
Keep your stride steady and breathing controlled.
Cover a set distance, then rest.

3035.description: From all fours, you lift one bent leg out to the side. It works the outer hip and glutes.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a flat back.
Keep your knee bent at about 90 degrees.
Lift the bent leg out to the side to hip height.
Squeeze your outer hip at the top without rotating your torso.
Lower under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3227.description: Lying face down, you flutter your legs like a swimmer. It works the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended in front.
Lift your chest and legs slightly off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small, fast alternations.
Keep your neck long.
Breathe steadily.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

3291.description: A gymnastics press where you shift your weight over the hands and lift the body up with straight arms. It trains the triceps and shoulders.
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended overhead.
Bend your knees slightly and engage your core.
Lower your body down into a squat position while keeping your arms extended overhead.
As you squat down, press your arms down towards the ground, engaging your triceps.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the squat, then push through your heels to stand back up while simultaneously raising your arms back overhead.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，双臂伸过头顶。
稍微弯曲膝盖并启动核心。
将身体降低至蹲姿，同时保持手臂伸过头顶。
当你蹲下时，将手臂向下压向地面，锻炼三头肌。
在深蹲底部停顿片刻，然后用脚后跟站起来，同时将手臂举过头顶。
重复所需的重复次数。

3355.description: A second variation of the cable side lunge for the glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Hold a cable handle at chest height, standing sideways to the stack.
Step wide to the side and bend that knee.
Push your hips back and keep your chest up.
Push off the bent leg to return.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

3419.description: A seated hold on the floor, hands beside the hips, with the legs lifted straight out. It trains the abs, hip flexors and triceps.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Place your hands on the floor beside your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Engage your core and lift your legs off the ground, keeping them straight.
Try to bring your legs parallel to the floor, forming an 'L' shape with your body.
Hold this position for as long as you can.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在地板上，双腿伸到身前。
将双手放在臀部旁边的地板上，手指指向前方。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬离地面，保持伸直。
尝试使双腿与地面平行，与身体形成“L”形。
尽可能长时间地保持这个姿势。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3483.description: A face-down superman hold with the arms sweeping in a circle. It strengthens the glutes, lower back and rear shoulders.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Sweep your arms out to the sides and down toward your hips in a wide arc.
Sweep them back overhead along the same path.
Keep your neck neutral and legs lifted throughout.
Lower down with control after your set.

3547.description: A seated dumbbell curl that flows straight into an overhead press. It trains the biceps and shoulders in one rep.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward and arms fully extended.
Keeping your elbows close to your sides, curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders.
Once your forearms are vertical, rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing forward.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position by reversing the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
每只手握住一个哑铃，手掌朝前，双臂完全伸展。
保持肘部靠近身体两侧，将哑铃向上弯向肩膀。
前臂垂直后，旋转手腕，使手掌朝前。
将哑铃推过头顶，直到手臂完全伸展。
通过反向运动将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3675.description: Jump rope while hopping side to side to raise your heart rate and improve agility.
instructions: Hold the rope handles and stand tall.
Swing the rope overhead.
Hop side to side over the rope.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm.

3739.description: A bench press holding the kettlebell upside down, which forces tight control of the shoulder and wrist.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a kettlebell upside down above your chest.
Squeeze the handle and keep your wrist stacked.
Lower the bell slowly toward your chest.
Press it back up while keeping it balanced.
Use a light weight and switch arms after your reps.

3867.description: A walk in a deep squat that challenges the quads, hips and balance.
instructions: Lower into a deep squat with your chest up.
Place your hands on your hips or in front of you for balance.
Step forward with one foot, keeping the squat low.
Step with the other foot and continue walking.
Keep your heels down and your back straight.
Walk for a set distance or time.

3995.description: Swing your arms across your body, wrapping them around the trunk. It loosens the upper back and shoulders.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Swing your arms wide.
Wrap them around your body so the hands slap your upper back.
Open them wide again.
Keep it loose and rhythmic.

4059.description: Split squat holding a kettlebell, working the thighs and glutes one leg at a time.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest and take a long split stance.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

4123.description: A front squat holding one kettlebell on one side, challenging legs and core stability.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your shoulder with one hand.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Switch sides after your set.

4187.description: A sit up with legs pulled to the side while holding an EZ bar. It works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back holding an EZ bar over your chest.
Bend your knees.
Sit up while pulling your knees to one side.
Lower slowly.
Repeat on the other side.
Keep the bar stable.

4251.description: A sit-up with a rotation while holding a dumbbell on straight arms. It works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a dumbbell over your chest.
Sit up while keeping your arms straight.
Twist toward one side at the top.
Return to centre and lower slowly.
Alternate sides on each rep.
Keep your feet down and movement controlled.

4315.description: A seated pilates stretch where you round forward over your legs, one vertebra at a time. It mobilizes the spine and stretches the hamstrings.
instructions: Sit tall with legs extended hip-width apart and arms reaching forward.
Flex your feet and lift your torso up out of your hips.
Curl your chin to your chest and round forward, reaching past your toes.
Hold for a breath, then stack your spine back up slowly.
Repeat for several slow reps.

4379.description: A bodyweight row with a band added for extra load. It builds the upper back and biceps while your core keeps the body straight.
instructions: Anchor the band to a sturdy bar or rack and hold it while lying under the anchor point.
Keep your body in a straight line with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up toward your hands, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower yourself under control until your arms are straight.

4443.description: A rear-foot-elevated split squat with a dumbbell in one hand and the other hand on a support. Builds single-leg strength in the quads and glutes.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and rest the other hand on a sturdy support, standing away from a bench.
Place the top of your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Step your front foot far enough forward to stay balanced.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the front heel to stand, then switch legs after your set.

4571.description: A push-up with a band across your back that adds resistance at the top of the movement.
instructions: Loop the band across your upper back and hold the ends under your hands.
Get into a plank position with your body straight.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press up against the band until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and hips level.
Lower slowly for the next rep.

4699.description: A pedaling motion on your back with band resistance. It works the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with the band looped around your feet and hold the ends.
Raise your legs and shoulders slightly off the floor.
Pedal one leg in while extending the other.
Twist your torso to bring the opposite elbow to the knee.
Keep a steady rhythm and keep your core tight.

4763.description: A sit-up on the glute ham developer ending with a twist. It trains the abs and the obliques.
instructions: Lock your feet in the GHD and lie back with arms crossed or hands clasped.
Sit up in a controlled way.
At the top, rotate your torso to one side.
Return to the middle and lower back down.
Alternate the twist side each rep.

4891.description: From a hang you lift the legs and sweep them to one side in a half circle. It builds oblique strength and grip.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm overhand grip.
Raise both legs together toward one side of the bar.
Sweep them across the front in a half circle.
Lower the legs on the other side under control.
Keep the swing small and your shoulders active.
Repeat, alternating the direction.

5147.description: Use a band to pull yourself into a front rack position. It stretches your wrists, lats and shoulders.
instructions: Loop a band around a sturdy anchor and hold it with both hands in a front rack position.
Step back and let the band help your elbows lift.
Keep your elbows high and chest tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release the tension slowly.

5275.description: Lying with the legs up, reach your hands toward your toes. It trains the upper abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight up.
Reach your arms up toward your toes.
Lift your shoulders off the floor and touch your toes.
Lower your shoulders slowly.
Keep your legs steady.

5403.description: A gentle standing rotation with a stick across your shoulders. Loosens the mid back and trunk.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and rest a stick across your upper back.
Hold it with both hands and keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your upper body slowly to one side.
Pause for a moment, then rotate to the other side.
Repeat for 10-12 slow turns and keep your knees soft.

5659.description: Squat starting from the bottom position, pausing each rep to build strength.
instructions: Set the bar in safety pins at the bottom of a squat.
Get under it and brace.
Drive up from a dead stop.
Lower back to the pins.
Reset on every rep.

5915.description: A low plank with one leg lifted. Adds a balance challenge to the arms and core.
instructions: Start in a high plank and lift one leg behind you.
Keep your hips level.
Bend your elbows back and lower.
Hold briefly with your body in line.
Press up, lower the leg and switch.

5979.description: A cone drill in an X pattern that mixes sprints, shuffles and backpedals for agility.
instructions: Set four cones in a square, with a center point.
Sprint diagonally from one corner through the center to the opposite corner.
Shuffle sideways along one edge to the next corner.
Backpedal or sprint diagonally again.
Stay low through turns and repeat.

6043.description: A hip-driven swing with a weighted bottle held in both hands. It trains the glutes and hamstrings explosively.
instructions: Stand with feet wider than your hips, holding a bottle with both hands.
Hinge back and let the bottle swing between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and let the bottle swing to chest height.
Keep your arms relaxed, the hips do the work.
Let it fall back and hinge into the next rep.

6299.description: A seated wide-leg arm balance with legs extended out to the sides. It needs hip flexibility and core strength.
instructions: Squat with hands on the floor in front of you.
Place your knees high on your upper arms.
Lean forward and lift your feet off the floor.
Extend your legs wide to the sides.
Hold for a few breaths, then release.

6363.description: An overhand wrist curl on a low cable that works the top of your forearms with constant tension.
instructions: Face a low cable and grab the handle with an overhand grip.
Step back and let your arms hang with elbows close to your sides.
Extend your wrists to pull the handle upward.
Hold for a second.
Lower under control and repeat.

6555.description: A sit-up on a shaped ab mat that supports the lower back and allows a fuller range of motion.
instructions: Lie back on an ab mat with knees bent and feet flat.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands by your ears.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting tall.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower back down slowly.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

6747.description: A kneeling move pressing one leg back to fire the glute. Great for learning to feel the glutes work.
instructions: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Press one foot back and up, leading with the heel.
Squeeze the glute at the top without arching your back.
Lower with control.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

6811.description: A gentle release for the muscle under the shoulder blade using a stick for leverage. It helps the shoulder feel looser.
instructions: Hold a stick in one hand and bend your elbow to 90 degrees.
Place the other hand on the stick and rotate the arm outward.
Gently push into a comfortable stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other arm.

8987.description: From a half kneeling position you shift your weight sideways to open the hips and inner thigh. It builds hip mobility.
instructions: Start in a half kneeling position with one knee down and the other foot forward.
Turn your front foot out to the side.
Shift your hips sideways toward the straight leg.
Keep your chest up and feel the inner thigh open.
Return to the center with control.
Do all reps, then switch sides.

9691.description: A bodyweight squat with your heels raised. It shifts the work to the quads and allows a deeper position.
instructions: Place your heels on a low plate or wedge.
Hold your hands in front of your chest.
Sit down into a deep squat with your chest tall.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press up to stand and repeat.

9819.description: From a hang, you bring your knees up toward your chest to work the lower abs.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms straight.
Brace your abs and avoid swinging.
Raise your knees toward your chest.
Tilt your pelvis up at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

10139.description: Hold a ball under your heels in a curled position. It builds endurance in the back of the thighs.
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs out and the ball under your heels.
Lean back on your hands.
Press your heels into the ball and slide it in until knees bend.
Hold the position steadily.
Slowly extend your legs again.

10331.description: A curl that adds a forearm twist, mimicking arm wrestling to build the biceps and forearms.
instructions: Stand on a resistance band and hold the handle with your palm turned to the side.
Curl the handle up while rotating your wrist.
Finish with your palm facing you and the biceps squeezed.
Lower slowly and untwist back to the start.
Keep your elbow tucked. Finish the reps, then switch arms.

10651.description: A standing hip abduction on a bosu ball against band tension. It works the outer hip and challenges your balance.
instructions: Place a band around your ankles and stand on the bosu with one foot.
Hold your core tight and stay tall.
Lift your free leg out to the side against the band.
Pause briefly at the top.
Return slowly without leaning.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

10907.description: A half split position that stretches the back of the front leg while you sit back on the rear leg.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other leg extended in front, heel on the floor.
Sit your hips back toward the rear heel.
Keep the front leg straight and your back long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

0027.description: A hip-hinged row pulling the bar to your lower chest. A staple for the upper back and lats.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Bend forward at the hips while keeping your back straight and chest up.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Pull the barbell towards your lower chest by retracting your shoulder blades and squeezing your back muscles.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
臀部向前弯曲，同时保持背部挺直、挺胸。
正手握住杠铃，双手间距略宽于肩宽。
通过收缩肩胛骨并挤压背部肌肉，将杠铃拉向下胸部。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0091.description: A seated overhead press with the barbell. Builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell off the rack and bring it to shoulder level, with your elbows bent and palms facing forward.
Press the barbell overhead by extending your arms fully.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
正手握住杠铃，杠铃间距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃从架子上提起，并将其置于与肩同高的位置，肘部弯曲，手掌朝前。
充分伸展双臂，将杠铃压过头顶。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回肩部水平。
重复所需的重复次数。

0155.description: A variation of the cable crossover for the chest.
instructions: Adjust the cable pulleys to chest height.
Stand in the center of the cable machine with one foot in front of the other.
Grasp the handles with your palms facing down and your arms extended out to the sides.
Take a step forward, keeping your arms slightly bent.
With a slight bend in your elbows, bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将电缆滑轮调整至胸部高度。
站在电缆机的中央，一只脚在另一只脚前面。
手掌朝下抓住手柄，手臂向两侧伸展。
向前迈出一步，保持手臂稍微弯曲。
肘部稍微弯曲，双手并拢放在胸前。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0219.description: A standing overhead press using cable handles. The constant tension challenges the shoulders and triceps all the way up.
instructions: Adjust the cable machine so that the handles are at shoulder height.
Stand facing away from the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and bring them up to shoulder level, with your elbows bent and pointing outwards.
Press the handles upwards until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the handles back down to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整绳索机，使手柄位于肩部高度。
背对机器站立，双脚与肩同宽。
正手握住手柄，将其提升至肩部水平，肘部弯曲并指向外侧。
向上按压手柄，直到手臂完全伸过头顶。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手柄放回至肩部水平。
重复所需的重复次数。

0283.description: A push-up with the hands forming a diamond under the chest. It puts heavy focus on the triceps.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands close together, forming a diamond shape with your thumbs and index fingers.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to toe, engaging your core and glutes.
Lower your chest towards the diamond shape formed by your hands, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从高位平板支撑开始，双手并拢，拇指和食指形成菱形。
让你的身体从头到脚保持一条直线，锻炼你的核心和臀部。
将胸部降低至双手形成的菱形，保持肘部靠近身体。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0347.description: A lying forearm rotation with a dumbbell, turning the palm from facing in to facing down. It works the muscles that control forearm rotation.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your chest facing down and your arms extended straight down, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Rotate your palms so they are facing up.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the dumbbells as you rotate your palms to face down.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，胸部朝下，双臂伸直向下，每只手各握一个哑铃。
旋转手掌，使手掌朝上。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯曲哑铃，同时将手掌旋转至面朝下。
吸气并慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0411.description: You squat down on one leg while holding a dumbbell, then stand up. It builds single-leg strength and balance.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Extend one leg forward and keep it off the ground throughout the exercise.
Bend your standing leg and lower your body down as if sitting back into a chair.
Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
向前伸展一条腿，并在整个练习过程中保持其离开地面。
弯曲站立的腿并降低身体，就像坐回椅子上一样。
保持挺胸、背部挺直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后用脚跟推动回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

0475.description: Hanging from a bar, you raise your straight legs in front of you. It builds the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your legs up in front of you, keeping them straight.
Continue lifting until your legs are parallel to the ground or as high as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬起到你面前，保持伸直。
继续抬起，直到双腿与地面平行或达到您可以舒适地达到的高度。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0539.description: A standing one arm kettlebell press where the path drifts out to the side. Works the shoulder and upper back while your core resists leaning.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand at shoulder height.
Engage your core and keep your back straight.
Press the kettlebell overhead, extending your arm fully.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the kettlebell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住壶铃，与肩同高。
启动你的核心并保持背部挺直。
将壶铃压过头顶，充分伸展手臂。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将壶铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0603.description: Seated at a lever machine, you press the handles overhead. Builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the backrest.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your hands at shoulder level.
Push the handles upward until your arms are fully extended, but do not lock your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the handles back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在机器上，背部靠在靠背上。
正手握住手柄，并将双手置于肩部水平。
向上推动手柄，直到手臂完全伸展，但不要锁住肘部。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0667.description: A push-up performed with one leg lifted. It challenges the chest, shoulders and core stability.
instructions: Start in a push-up position.
Lift one leg off the floor.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up without twisting your hips.
Keep your body in a line.
Switch the lifted leg every set.

0731.description: A one-legged wall sit that doubles the load on each leg and challenges balance and quad endurance.
instructions: Lean your back against a wall and slide down into a wall sit.
Shift your weight onto one foot.
Lift the other leg and extend it in front of you.
Hold for 10-30 seconds while keeping your back flat on the wall.
Lower the leg and rest, then switch sides.
Keep your standing knee over your ankle.

0795.description: A bodyweight hamstring curl done standing on one leg, bringing the heel toward the glutes. It trains the hamstrings and balance.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on your hips.
Shift your weight onto your left leg and lift your right foot off the ground, bending your knee.
Slowly curl your right heel towards your glutes, squeezing your hamstring.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your right foot back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽，双手放在臀部。
将体重转移到左腿上，将右脚抬离地面，弯曲膝盖。
慢慢地将右脚跟卷向臀部，挤压腿筋。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将右脚放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

0859.description: A wrist roller that winds a weight up on a rope or bar by turning the wrists. It builds the forearms and grip.
instructions: Attach a weight to one end of a rope or bar.
Hold the other end of the rope or bar with both hands, palms facing down.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms fully extended in front of you.
Slowly roll the weight up towards your hands by flexing your wrists.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the weight back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将重物固定在绳子或杆的一端。
用双手握住绳子或杆的另一端，手掌朝下。
双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂完全伸展在身前。
弯曲手腕，慢慢地将重物向上滚动到手上。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将重量放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0923.description: A standing press angled upward using a band. It targets the upper chest.
instructions: Anchor the band low behind you and hold the ends at your chest.
Step into a staggered stance.
Press your hands up and forward.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Return slowly.

0987.description: A single-leg split squat with a band, back foot raised. It trains the quads and glutes.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place a resistance band around your ankles.
Extend one leg forward and rest the top of your foot on a bench or step behind you.
Hold onto a support with one hand for balance.
Bend your standing leg and lower your body down into a squat position, keeping your knee in line with your toes.
Push through your heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开站立，与臀部同宽，将阻力带绕在脚踝上。
向前伸出一条腿，将脚尖放在长凳上或身后的一步上。
用一只手握住支撑物以保持平衡。
弯曲站立的腿，将身体降低到蹲姿，保持膝盖与脚趾在一条直线上。
推动脚后跟返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。
